title: VENU Hosts Special Event for Ford Amphitheater Investors Featuring VENU Shareholder Dierks Bentley
summary: Venu Holding Corporation ("VENU" or the "Company") (NYSE AMERICAN: VENU), an owner, operator, and developer of premium live entertainment destinations, today announced it hosted a dedicated evening for Colorado based Ford Amphitheater Luxe FireSuite ® and Owners Club investors, featuring GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum recording artist and VENU ® shareholder Dierks Bentley. Dierks Bentley Unplugged Pre-Party in Colorado Springs, CO | Photo Credit: Keni Mac The event took place Thursday, July 2nd, at Phil Long Music Hall at Bourbon Brothers, ahead of Bentley's performance on the Company's Ford Amphitheater main stage as part of his Off the Map tour, marking his return to Ford Amphitheater this summer. The evening included a curated question and answer session with VENU Chief Operating Officer, Vic Sutter, and a live acoustic performance of several of Bentley's most beloved hits, giving shareholders a rare, close-up look at the artist whose stake in VENU, and role as a founding member
